title: Pyxo No Hassle A/V 8x8 HDMI 4K Matrix Switcher

user.title: Connect a matrix
user.description: Choose UDP with an IP address or hostname, or a local serial port at 115200 8N1. Only fields for the chosen connection are used. Setup does not connect to or test the matrix. Serial carriage return is optional; UDP never appends a newline. Serial ports are listed by persistent device ID when available. Numbered Linux USB ports are converted to a by-id path, or by-path if no ID exists. If neither exists, a manually entered path may change after a host reboot; configure a stable OS device mapping.

labels.title: Input and output names
labels.description: Optionally name any physical inputs and outputs. Leave fields blank to use Input 1–8 and Output 1–8 defaults. Labels can be changed later. Routing state is assumed, saved locally, and restored after Home Assistant restarts. There is no hardware readback. Reboot is optional and disruptive.

error.invalid_connection: Enter a name and valid connection settings. UDP requires an IP address or hostname and port 1–65535. Serial requires a local /dev/... or COM port.
error.invalid_labels: Names must be at most 100 characters, and input names must be unique within the matrix. Leave unused names blank to use Input 1–8 or Output 1–8 defaults.
